items.title: Know when your holds are ready
items.text: Get an alert with the book's cover when a hold is waiting for you. Press and hold the alert to see the details, then tap See my holds or get directions to the library.
items.note: We're still testing these alerts, so they may not arrive on their own yet.

items.title: A faster Home screen
items.text: Home opens quicker, and covers you've already seen show up right away.

items.title: Takes up less space
items.text: The app is now about a quarter smaller on your phone.

items.title: Home Screen widgets
items.text: See what's due next and which holds are ready, right from your Home Screen.

items.title: Find your way inside
items.text: Bellevue Library now has a floor map. Tap Inside the library on the branch page.

items.title: Staff picks
items.text: Browse reading lists from KCLS staff on Home and in Search.
